# Paul Irving

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 years old  <sub>[v2 c1 P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047)</sub>
- **Origin:** Boston, United States  <sub>[v2 c1 P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolboy and student  <sub>[v2 c1 P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>

## Appearance

Paul is a brown-haired schoolboy with naturally curly hair and eyes that match the color of his father's. He has a small, sturdy, and brown frame that grows noticeably taller during his time in Avonlea. He bears a physical resemblance to his deceased mother.

_Sources: [v2 c19 P25](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0025), [v2 c28 P27](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0027)_

## Personality

Paul is a quiet, meditative, and fair-minded boy with a vivid imagination and deep insight. He frequently shares imaginative stories about rock people, fairies, dryads, and dream worlds with receptive listeners. Despite his gentle and imaginative nature, he is manly, courageous, and capable of standing up for himself and his beliefs in physical games and fights. He is protective of younger children and respectful of those around him.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c19 P28](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0028)_

- Imaginative and poetic  <sub>[v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c19 P33](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0033)</sub>

- To confide his imaginative thoughts to people who understand him  <sub>[v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041)</sub>
- To please his father and grandmother by doing his daily duties  <sub>[v2 c19 P10](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0010), [v2 c28 P28](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0028)</sub>

## History

Following the death of his mother, Paul was sent from Boston to Avonlea to reside with his grandmother, Mrs. Irving. He enrolled in the local school under the instruction of Anne Shirley, with whom he formed a swift and affectionate bond based on their mutual love for imaginative fancies. During his time at school, he engaged in a drawn battle with St. Clair Donnell to defend his American patriotism and stood up as a gentlemanly and protective figure among his peers. He also made regular visits to Miss Lavendar at Echo Lodge, connecting with her over her concept of a 'dream-boy' and sharing his tales of rock people and dream worlds. After two years in Avonlea, his father Stephen Irving returned, rekindling his romance with Miss Lavendar. Following their marriage, Paul moved to Boston alongside Charlotta the Fourth to reside with his father and stepmother, with plans to later study abroad for two years.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083), [v2 c28 P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 c28 P45](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0045)_

## Quotes

> I think the most interesting people I know are my rock people and I mean to tell you about them.
